propositions: GitHub Code Quality (CodeQL) identified 631 Standard findings and 6 AI findings; 31 were classified as mechanical, no-behavior-change fixes suitable for immediate remediation.
File-not-closed violations in _store/ensures.py (2 instances), _io/export_ndjson.py, and test modules require wrapping open() calls in `with` statements.
Unnecessary-lambda violations in audit/page.py and _snapshot/janitor.py require replacing lambda wrappers with direct callable references.
Repeated-import violations in attest/opcert.py and llm/structured.py require removing redundant function-local re-imports.
Four AI test-cleanups target redundant local imports and split chained `and` assertions in test_editor.py and test_validation_depth.py.
Gerrit change 809 applied all 31 fixes plus enabled ruff SIM115 rule as preventive measure for file-not-closed class (7 codebase hits); merged to main after LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
